description: This file defines the LearnFragment class for an Android app, which manages a UI with tabbed navigation between TutorialFragment and TatweejFragment, utilizing a ViewPager2 and TabLayoutMediator.

classes.name: LearnFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a tabbed interface with two pages, 'Tutorial' and 'Tatweej', using ViewPager2 and TabLayoutMediator.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the tab layout and view pager, sets up the list of pages, and connects the TabLayout with ViewPager2 to enable tabbed navigation.
